architecture_principles: Do not port gameplay by copying Worker blobs into Godot scenes.
Extract behavioral contracts from the JavaScript Worker before implementation.
Keep JavaScript Phase 35.13R as the production and regression reference until G-6 explicitly changes deployment policy.
Migrate systems through small, validator-backed Godot services with save/schema compatibility tests.
Any player-facing or visual migration still requires screenshot evidence and council inspection.
Server-authoritative multiplayer remains a future trust-boundary target, not a G-5 implementation task.

target_godot_boundaries.responsibility: Own canonical player, quest, world, creature, inventory, and progression state in Godot without binding to rendering nodes.
Read, migrate, repair, validate, and write Wayfarer save payloads through adapters for local browser storage, Godot storage, and future server persistence.
Own zone ids, transitions, spawn safety, region membership, and future network zone assignment.
Resolve proximity/click/key interactions against stable entity ids and dispatch dialogue, vendor, object, and transition commands.
Run dialogue roots, quest lifecycle, objective updates, rewards, and branch conditions from data contracts.
Own item registry, stacking, equip validation, vendor pricing, buy/sell accounting, consumables, and reward application.
Own deterministic combat formulas, hit validation, enemy defeat, cooldowns, and reward outcome production.
Normalize stable ids for players, NPCs, enemies, props, chests, signs, doors, and persistent objects.
Keep sprites, HUD, prompts, Chronicle text, animations, camera, and VFX as subscribers to domain events rather than owners of canonical mutations.
Run parity fixtures, save compatibility checks, Godot vertical slice validation, screenshots where applicable, and council acceptance reports.

migration_systems.data_contract: Zone id, world position, facing, velocity/input intent, safe spawn, transition lock, and camera bounds.
validation_gates: Movement parity fixtures for blocked/open route samples
Runtime screenshot proof when camera or player presentation changes
migration_systems.risk: Grid-to-continuous movement semantics can change quest/combat reachability if not fixture-locked.

migration_systems.current_javascript_evidence: InteractionManager, DialogueFramework, QuestStateSystem, quest event hooks, branch conditions, and reward turn-ins are embedded in worker/src/index.js.
migration_systems.current_godot_surface: EdrinVale.gd and Player.gd provide one interactable dialogue prompt in Newport.
migration_systems.data_contract: NPC id, object id, prompt text, dialogue node id, condition query, quest state, objective id, reward command, and idempotency token.
validation_gates: Quest lifecycle fixtures for Hunter's Request and The Still Water
Dialogue branch fixtures by quest/equipment state
Screenshot proof for dialogue UI changes
migration_systems.risk: Hardcoded quest and NPC paths can duplicate rewards or lose branch reactivity during migration.

migration_systems.current_javascript_evidence: ITEM_REGISTRY, inventory normalization, equipment slots, vendor buy/sell, consumable use, skill healing bonus, and coin accounting live in worker/src/index.js.
migration_systems.current_godot_surface: Godot HUD shows placeholder level/vitals but does not own inventory, equipment, vendor, or consumable behavior yet.
migration_systems.data_contract: Item registry entry, stack quantity, equipment slot, vendor offer, coin delta, consumable effect, and inventory mutation result.
validation_gates: Consumable HP cap and Survival XP fixtures
migration_systems.risk: Direct UI/save side effects in the Worker can hide mutation-order bugs if not isolated first.

migration_systems.current_javascript_evidence: Enemy spawn tables, wolf/bandit/Rook/cave-wolf loops, cooldowns, damage, death, loot rolls, XP, levels, skills, recoil, and combat feedback live in worker/src/index.js.
migration_systems.current_godot_surface: Godot Newport currently has player movement and visual presentation only; combat and enemies are not ported.
migration_systems.data_contract: Actor id, faction, HP, attack range, cooldown, damage formula inputs, hit result, defeat result, loot roll seed/outcome, XP and skill XP deltas.
validation_gates: Formula parity fixtures for damage and defense
Combat feedback screenshot/video proof after visual integration
migration_systems.risk: Client-authoritative combat cannot become multiplayer-safe until formulas and outcome mutations are pure and server-reusable.

migration_systems.current_javascript_evidence: saveSchemaVersion 2, migrateSave, repairSave, validateSaveData, createSaveData, saveGame, loadGame, backup slot protection, and localStorage ownership live in worker/src/index.js.
migration_systems.current_godot_surface: Godot Newport has no production save system yet.
migration_systems.data_contract: Save schema version, canonical player payload, quest payload, world payload, systems payload, migration result, repair warnings, adapter result, and idempotent write result.
validation_gates: Golden JS save payload load fixtures
Godot-to-JS compatibility export fixture before production cutover
migration_systems.risk: Save compatibility is the highest player-trust risk; Godot must read and preserve legacy progress before replacing the Worker route.

migration_systems.current_javascript_evidence: Persistent object ids, Mirror Cave chest states, Echo Fragment state, Abandoned Tollhouse/Rook/chest clear states, dungeon transitions, and POI discovery are implemented in worker/src/index.js.
migration_systems.current_godot_surface: Godot Newport has collision/detail blockers and one NPC; dungeons and persistent object state are not ported.
migration_systems.data_contract: Persistent object id, object type, state enum, discovered/opened/defeated/cleared flags, transition request, safe return point, and one-time reward lock.
validation_gates: Tollhouse Rook plus chest clear-state fixtures
migration_systems.risk: Object and dungeon state is reward-sensitive and must be idempotent before shared or server-backed play.

migration_systems.current_javascript_evidence: DOM HUD, sidebar tabs, Chronicle/chat log, dialogue/vendor panels, reward toasts, floating text, HP/stat labels, and QA overlays live in worker/src/index.js.
migration_systems.current_godot_surface: HUD.gd provides Newport player-facing status, quest panel, dialogue panel, metadata toggle, and no-HUD review mode.
migration_systems.data_contract: HUD state snapshot, dialogue surface state, vendor surface state, Chronicle event, toast event, floating text event, and review metadata mode.

migration_systems.current_javascript_evidence: Cloudflare Worker serves the JS route, runtime QA reports live in the browser bundle, and the multiplayer plan selects Worker router plus Durable Objects plus D1 for future authority.
migration_systems.current_godot_surface: Godot exports to a separate browser review path and uses headless validators plus screenshot capture.
migration_systems.data_contract: Deployment target, route owner, validation command, screenshot packet, PR check result, rollback trigger, and authority boundary classification.
validation_gates: Pre-G-5 ledger validator retained as prerequisite
G-6 cutover plan before any production route replacement
migration_systems.risk: Replacing hosting before system parity and rollback criteria would strand the mature JS route and violate roadmap safety.

migration_sequence.name: Contract Extraction And Golden Fixtures
migration_sequence.objective: Extract JS behavior contracts, golden save payloads, and parity fixtures before writing gameplay ports.
migration_sequence.exit_gate: Contracts and fixtures exist for movement, save, quest, inventory, combat, objects, and UI feedback.

migration_sequence.name: Godot State Kernel Skeleton
migration_sequence.objective: Create service boundaries and data models without enabling player-facing gameplay regressions.
migration_sequence.exit_gate: GameState, EntityRegistry, ZoneService, and QA harness load fixtures headlessly.

migration_sequence.name: Save Compatibility Bridge
migration_sequence.objective: Teach Godot to read, repair, preserve, and export Wayfarer save schema v2 before progression systems arrive.
migration_sequence.exit_gate: Golden JS saves round-trip in Godot without player data loss.

migration_sequence.name: Interaction Dialogue Quest Foundation
migration_sequence.objective: Migrate NPC/object interaction, dialogue branches, quest objectives, and reward commands through data services.
migration_sequence.entry_gate: Save bridge can persist quest/world state.
migration_sequence.exit_gate: Hunter's Request and The Still Water fixtures pass without duplicate rewards.

migration_sequence.name: Inventory Equipment Economy Foundation
migration_sequence.objective: Migrate item registry, stack rules, equipment, vendor accounting, consumables, and save persistence.
migration_sequence.entry_gate: Quest rewards have a service target.
migration_sequence.exit_gate: Buy, sell, equip, consume, and save/reload fixtures pass.

migration_sequence.name: Combat Enemy Loot Foundation
migration_sequence.objective: Migrate deterministic combat formulas, enemies, defeat, loot, XP, skills, respawn, and feedback events.
migration_sequence.entry_gate: Inventory/equipment and save services are stable.
migration_sequence.exit_gate: Wolf, bandit, cave wolf, and Rook fixture outcomes match accepted balance contracts.

migration_sequence.name: Dungeon Persistent Object Foundation
migration_sequence.objective: Migrate Mirror Cave, Abandoned Tollhouse, chests, Echo Fragment, Rook cleared state, and transition safety.
migration_sequence.entry_gate: Combat and object command services exist.
migration_sequence.exit_gate: Dungeon rewards and clear states are idempotent across save/reload.

migration_sequence.name: Player-Facing Feedback Integration
migration_sequence.objective: Bind domain events to Godot HUD, dialogue, Chronicle, toasts, floating text, and screenshot-validated player feedback.
migration_sequence.entry_gate: Core systems emit events rather than mutating UI directly.
migration_sequence.exit_gate: Combat, rewards, quest, save, and vendor feedback clears visual/UX QA.

migration_sequence.name: Parity And Cutover Readiness Evidence
migration_sequence.objective: Produce side-by-side JS/Godot parity validation, performance evidence, screenshots, and unresolved gap register for G-6.
migration_sequence.exit_gate: G-6 has concrete cutover inputs, rollback triggers, and no hidden parity gaps.

g6_inputs: Rollback plan from Godot route back to JavaScript Worker route
Human-facing release criteria for replacing the Worker route
